<!--
Playful homepage hero collage (originally prototyped as a standalone HTML
mockup, irw_homepage_hero_playful_v2.html). All markup/CSS/animation logic
below is that prototype, unchanged in visual language -- the only thing this
port does is source the stamp numbers and ×N badges from data/hero_stats.json
instead of hand-typed strings, plus scope every CSS selector under
`.irw-hero` (the prototype used bare selectors like `.card`, `.row`, and `.count`,
which would collide with Bootstrap/Cosmo classes of the same name once this
stops being a standalone page).
-->

```{r}
#| label: load-hero-stats
#| include: false

library(jsonlite)

# Emergency fallback only: used if data/hero_stats.json is missing or fails
# to parse at build time (e.g. accidental deletion, bad merge). This keeps
# `quarto render` from failing rather than being a source of truth -- it is
# NOT refreshed automatically by metadata/00_hero_totals.R or
# metadata/00_hero_category_breakdown.R (those write the checked-in JSON
# file), so it will drift stale over time. Update by hand only if the
# checked-in JSON itself is broken and a rebuild is needed before a fix
# lands.
hero_stats_fallback <- list(
  generated_at = "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  totals = list(n_tables = 1300, n_responses = 27000000000, n_participants = 65000000, n_items = 730000),
  category_breakdown = list(
    list(n_categories = 2,    n_items = 148589, n_responses = 2112679586),
    list(n_categories = 3,    n_items = 11974,  n_responses = 28686057),
    list(n_categories = 4,    n_items = 31583,  n_responses = 54052143),
    list(n_categories = 5,    n_items = 86988,  n_responses = 172105890),
    list(n_categories = 6,    n_items = 18967,  n_responses = 6905164),
    list(n_categories = "7+", n_items = 103551, n_responses = 127337448)
  )
)

hero_stats_path <- "data/hero_stats.json"

hero_stats <- tryCatch({
  parsed <- fromJSON(hero_stats_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  required_totals <- c("n_tables", "n_responses", "n_participants", "n_items")
  valid <- is.list(parsed$totals) && all(required_totals %in% names(parsed$totals)) &&
    is.list(parsed$category_breakdown)
  if (!valid) stop("hero_stats.json missing required fields")
  parsed
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("components/_hero_playful.qmd: ", hero_stats_path,
          " missing or malformed (", conditionMessage(e),
          ") -- rendering hero with fallback values.")
  hero_stats_fallback
})

ojs_define(hero_stats = hero_stats)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: hero-formatters

// Abbreviated K/M/B formatter for stamp numbers and ×N badges: 3 significant
// figures, trailing ".0" dropped (e.g. 172105890 -> "172M", 6905164 -> "6.9M").
fmtAbbrev = (n) => {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return "";
  const units = [[1e9, "B"], [1e6, "M"], [1e3, "K"]];
  for (const [threshold, suffix] of units) {
    if (Math.abs(n) >= threshold) {
      const scaled = n / threshold;
      const digits = Math.abs(scaled) >= 100 ? 0 : 1;
      return scaled.toFixed(digits).replace(/\.0$/, "") + suffix;
    }
  }
  return Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
}

// Thousands-grouped integer, used for the "tables" stamp (shown in full,
// not abbreviated, per the v2 prototype).
fmtInt = (n) => (n == null || isNaN(n)) ? "" : Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");

// Spelled-out magnitude for the tagline prose ("27 billion answers").
fmtWords = (n) => {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return "";
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1e9) return (Math.round(n / 1e8) / 10) + " billion";
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1e6) return (Math.round(n / 1e5) / 10) + " million";
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1e3) return (Math.round(n / 1e2) / 10) + " thousand";
  return fmtInt(n);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: hero-collage

// Fixed card -> response-category mapping (decision: explicit, not inferred
// at render time). "thumbs" has no entry in the v2 design -- intentionally
// left un-badged, matching the prototype.
heroCategoryMap = ({
  true_false:      2,
  multiple_choice: 4,
  likert:          5,
  stars:           5,
  checkbox:        3,
  confidence:      "7+",
  mood:            6
})

heroCategoryLookup = new Map(
  (hero_stats.category_breakdown || []).map(d => [String(d.n_categories), d])
)

// Hide a card's badge rather than render "×0" / "×NA" if its bucket is
// missing or zero in the current data refresh.
heroBadge = (key) => {
  const cat = heroCategoryMap[key];
  if (cat === undefined) return null;
  const row = heroCategoryLookup.get(String(cat));
  if (!row || !row.n_responses) return null;
  return "×" + fmtAbbrev(row.n_responses);
}

heroRoot = {
  const totals = hero_stats.totals || {};
  const intervals = [];
  const track = (id) => { intervals.push(id); return id; };

  const cards = [
    {kind:'card', top:'2%',  left:'1%',  rot:-6, color:'var(--irw-hero-blue)', count: heroBadge('true_false'),
     label:'True or False?', build:c=>{
        const wrap = document.createElement('div');
        wrap.innerHTML = `<div class="toggle" id="tg"><div class="knob2"></div></div><div class="toggle-lbl" id="tgl">FALSE</div>`;
        c.appendChild(wrap);
        const tg = wrap.querySelector('#tg'), lbl = wrap.querySelector('#tgl');
        let on=false;
        track(setInterval(()=>{ on=!on; tg.classList.toggle('tt',on); lbl.textContent = on?'TRUE':'FALSE'; }, 1400));
    }},
    {kind:'card', top:'0%', left:'23%', rot:4, color:'var(--irw-hero-pink)', count: heroBadge('multiple_choice'),
     label:'Pick one answer', build:c=>{
        const opts=['A) Paris','B) Rome','C) Cairo','D) Lima'];
        c.innerHTML = opts.map((o,i)=>`<div class="row"><span class="opt-circle" data-i="${i}"></span>${o}</div>`).join('');
        const circ = [...c.querySelectorAll('.opt-circle')];
        let i=0; circ[0].classList.add('on');
        track(setInterval(()=>{ circ[i].classList.remove('on'); i=(i+1)%circ.length; circ[i].classList.add('on'); }, 900));
    }},
    {kind:'stamp', top:'4%', left:'46%', rot:-4, color:'var(--irw-hero-purple)', n: fmtInt(totals.n_tables) + "+", l:'tables'},
    {kind:'card', top:'0%', left:'67%', rot:5, color:'var(--irw-hero-yellow)', count: heroBadge('stars'),
     label:'Rate this item', build:c=>{
        c.innerHTML = `<div class="stars" id="st"></div>`;
        const el = c.querySelector('#st');
        let n=0;
        track(setInterval(()=>{
          n = n%5 + 1;
          el.innerHTML = '<span class="star-f">'+'★'.repeat(n)+'</span>'+'<span class="star-e">'+'★'.repeat(5-n)+'</span>';
        }, 700));
    }},
    {kind:'card', top:'30%', left:'2%', rot:6, color:'var(--irw-hero-green)', count: heroBadge('likert'),
     label:'Strongly agree?', build:c=>{
        c.innerHTML = `<div class="scaleline">${[0,1,2,3,4].map(i=>`<span class="opt-circle" data-i="${i}"></span>`).join('')}</div>
                       <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:8px; color:#8a8496; margin-top:3px;"><span>disagree</span><span>agree</span></div>`;
        const circ = [...c.querySelectorAll('.opt-circle')];
        let i=0, dir=1; circ[0].classList.add('on');
        track(setInterval(()=>{
          circ[i].classList.remove('on');
          i+=dir; if(i===4||i===0) dir*=-1;
          circ[i].classList.add('on');
        }, 650));
    }},
    {kind:'stamp', top:'26%', left:'26%', rot:5, color:'var(--irw-hero-orange)', n: fmtAbbrev(totals.n_participants), l:'people'},
    {kind:'card', top:'26%', left:'48%', rot:-5, color:'var(--irw-hero-purple)', count: heroBadge('checkbox'),
     label:'Check all that apply', build:c=>{
        const items=['Fast','Careful','Confident'];
        c.innerHTML = items.map((t,i)=>`<div class="row"><span class="check" data-i="${i}"></span>${t}</div>`).join('');
        const boxes=[...c.querySelectorAll('.check')];
        let i=0;
        track(setInterval(()=>{
          boxes.forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('on'));
          for(let k=0;k<=i;k++) boxes[k].classList.add('on');
          i=(i+1)%boxes.length;
        }, 1000));
    }},
    {kind:'card', top:'30%', left:'71%', rot:4, color:'var(--irw-hero-blue)', count: heroBadge('confidence'),
     label:'How confident?', build:c=>{
        c.innerHTML = `<div class="track"><div class="knob" id="kn" style="left:0%"></div></div>
                       <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:8px; color:#8a8496;"><span>0</span><span>100</span></div>`;
        const kn = c.querySelector('#kn');
        let pos=0, dir=1;
        track(setInterval(()=>{ pos += dir*22; if(pos>=88||pos<=0) dir*=-1; kn.style.left=pos+'%'; }, 550));
    }},
    {kind:'card', top:'60%', left:'12%', rot:-3, color:'var(--irw-hero-yellow)', count: heroBadge('mood'),
     label:'How are you feeling?', build:c=>{
        c.innerHTML = `<div class="emoji-row"><span>😠</span><span>🙁</span><span>😐</span><span>🙂</span><span>😄</span></div>`;
        const em=[...c.querySelectorAll('span')];
        let i=2, dir=1; em[i].classList.add('on');
        track(setInterval(()=>{ em[i].classList.remove('on'); i+=dir; if(i===4||i===0) dir*=-1; em[i].classList.add('on'); }, 700));
    }},
    {kind:'stamp', top:'58%', left:'37%', rot:-6, color:'var(--irw-hero-green)', n: fmtAbbrev(totals.n_items) + "+", l:'items'},
    {kind:'card', top:'62%', left:'60%', rot:5, color:'var(--irw-hero-pink)', count:null,
     label:'Yes or no?', build:c=>{
        c.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:26px; text-align:center;" id="th">👍</div>`;
        const el=c.querySelector('#th'); let up=true;
        track(setInterval(()=>{ up=!up; el.textContent = up?'👍':'👎'; }, 1100));
    }},
  ];

  const collage = document.createElement('div');
  collage.className = 'collage';
  cards.forEach((cfg, idx) => {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.style.top = cfg.top; el.style.left = cfg.left;
    el.style.setProperty('--rot', cfg.rot + 'deg');
    el.style.animationDuration = (4 + (idx % 3) * 0.7) + 's';
    el.style.animationDelay = (idx * 0.25) + 's';
    el.style.zIndex = 10 + idx;

    if (cfg.kind === 'stamp') {
      el.className = 'stamp';
      el.style.background = cfg.color;
      el.innerHTML = `<div class="n">${cfg.n}</div><div class="l">${cfg.l}</div>`;
    } else {
      el.className = 'card';
      const lbl = document.createElement('div');
      lbl.className = 'lbl';
      lbl.innerHTML = `<span class="tag-dot" style="background:${cfg.color}"></span>${cfg.label}`;
      el.appendChild(lbl);
      if (cfg.count) {
        const badge = document.createElement('div');
        badge.className = 'count';
        badge.textContent = cfg.count;
        el.appendChild(badge);
      }
      const body = document.createElement('div');
      el.appendChild(body);
      cfg.build(body);
    }
    collage.appendChild(el);
  });

  const root = document.createElement('div');
  root.className = 'irw-hero';
  const heroEl = document.createElement('div');
  heroEl.className = 'hero';

  const head = document.createElement('div');
  head.className = 'head';
  head.innerHTML = `
    <span class="kicker">Item Response Warehouse</span>
    <h1>Every question<br/>ever answered, in <span class="hl">one place<svg viewBox="0 0 300 18" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M2 12 C 60 2, 140 18, 298 8" stroke="#ffca3a" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></span></h1>
    <p class="tag">${fmtWords(totals.n_responses)} answers. True/false, five-star, multiple choice, Likert — all reshaped into one format.</p>
    <a class="cta" href="data.qmd">Explore the warehouse →</a>
  `;
  heroEl.appendChild(head);
  heroEl.appendChild(collage);

  const footer = document.createElement('footer');
  footer.className = 'meta';
  const tfBadge = heroBadge('true_false');
  footer.textContent = `Each ×N badge is the total number of responses across IRW tables whose response scale uses that many categories (based on the response-category analysis in Domingue et al., 2025).` +
    (tfBadge ? ` 2-category tables (true/false-style) alone account for ${tfBadge.replace('×', '')} answers.` : '');
  heroEl.appendChild(footer);

  root.appendChild(heroEl);

  const shapes = [
    {t:'dot', top:'2%', left:'92%', size:10, color:'var(--irw-hero-green)'},
    {t:'star',top:'88%', left:'88%', color:'var(--irw-hero-purple)'},
    {t:'sq',  top:'90%', left:'2%', size:10, color:'var(--irw-hero-blue)'},
  ];
  shapes.forEach(s=>{
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'confetti ' + s.t;
    d.style.top = s.top; d.style.left = s.left;
    if (s.t === 'star') { d.textContent = '✦'; d.style.color = s.color; }
    else { d.style.width = s.size + 'px'; d.style.height = s.size + 'px'; d.style.background = s.color; d.style.border = '2.5px solid var(--irw-hero-ink)'; }
    heroEl.appendChild(d);
  });

  invalidation.then(() => intervals.forEach(id => clearInterval(id)));

  return root;
}

heroRoot
```
